data.name: Pain Wave
data.description: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to unleash a wave of pain. This wave hits all creatures other than you in a 20-foot-radius burst centered on a point that you designate within 100 feet. All living creatures in this area are wracked with pain, gaining the sickened condition for %1 rounds. Affected creatures can attempt a Will save (DC %2) to reduce the duration to just 1 round. This is a mind-affecting pain effect.|InvestigatorLVL|10+InvestigatorLVL/2+INT
